edit.statement: Every node on the network can send a message to itself.
edit.subject: canSendMessageTo
edit.original: A node on a network is not guaranteed to be able to send a message to itself; it depends on how the node is set up.
edit.scope: Whether a node on the network can deliver a message; sending to itself is not guaranteed for every node in the original rule.
